title: Oracle independence, precision floor, time-window and PML error budgets of every G3 fixture

fixture.document: docs/ORACLE_BUDGET.md: one row per fixture of every G3 case file present under docs/validation/cases, giving the oracle class, its independence from the code under test, the precision floor, the time window and the PML budget as recorded, plus the open residuals per task
fixture.case_files: docs/validation/cases/G3-*.json with the fields oracle_class (list) and tests.layers (one entry per tests.existing id with layer, oracle_class and oracle)
fixture.classes: analytic_continuum, analytic_discrete, independent_solver, physical_invariant, convergence_study (layer B); shared_discrete_operator, finite_difference_same_discretisation, independent_implementation_same_scheme (layer A); stored_record (either)

reference_method: Consistency of the documents of record with each other: every G3 case names allowed oracle classes, every listed test carries a layer consistent with its class and exists in its source file, the tasks G3-06, G3-09, G3-10, G3-11, G3-12 and G3-16 keep at least one layer-B entry, G3-14 and G3-15 are layer A only, and docs/ORACLE_BUDGET.md names every case id and every class.

observables.name: case_files_consistent
observables.definition: tests/test_oracle_budget.py passes on every docs/validation/cases/G3-*.json present

observables.name: document_coverage
observables.definition: every G3 case_id and every oracle class appears in docs/ORACLE_BUDGET.md

acceptance.source_of_limits: COMPLETION_PROGRAM_KO.md section 1 rule 8 (oracle classes must be distinguished) and section 5 (fixture-specific error budgets are declared before the run and differences from the common criteria are reported)

tests/test_oracle_budget.py::test_the_re.oracle: the case files of the tasks recorded in this branch exist

tests/test_oracle_budget.py::test_every_.oracle: listed test ids resolve to functions in the tree

tests/test_oracle_budget.py::test_oracle.oracle: document coverage of case ids and classes

not_yet_covered: rows for G3-01 to G3-05, G3-07, G3-08 and G3-13 in docs/ORACLE_BUDGET.md; their case files are written on other branches and the test enforces the class naming on them once merged

notes: This is a bookkeeping task; its evidence is the consistency test, not a physics measurement. The document records the budgets and open residuals found while writing the G3-06 to G3-16 cases on this branch, including the unexplained -0.69 percent Y-branch flux closure, the 2 percent fiber neff budget, the float32 VJP budgets of 2e-4 to 3e-4 and the tensor slab's missing reflection channel.
